request.subject: UNIT:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Change only the colours and the flag: his soft hat becomes deep crimson red with a gold-yellow band, keeping its shape and the white feather; his tunic becomes deep crimson red with a gold-yellow hem and a dark leather belt; the flag becomes deep crimson red with a gold-yellow lion and a gold-yellow border. Keep the steel helmet, the face, moustache, horn, banner pole, medieval clothes, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
